$comment: Maintainer ruling 2026-09-12: Copilot and zheref are the only expected reviewers. Copilot supplies automated review; zheref retains human approval/merge authority. A local agent never writes a human approval. For a maintainer-authored PR, report any unavailable GitHub self-approval as an unmet gate rather than synthesizing a review or substituting another identity.

delivery.$comment: Current local delivery branches use the Codex prefix and the maintainer credentials. No reviewer declares an approval carve-out.
